ayurvedic-hair-oil.author: Ananya Sharma
ayurvedic-hair-oil.title: Remarkable difference in hair fall and texture!
ayurvedic-hair-oil.body: I've tried numerous Ayurvedic oils, but Umanarayani Hair Oil has genuine herbal potency. The infusion of Brahmi, Nagarmotha, and Amarbel gives a cooling champi experience. After 3 weeks, my comb collects noticeably less hair and strands feel super soft.

ayurvedic-hair-oil.author: Vikram Joshi
ayurvedic-hair-oil.title: Authentic classical preparation without synthetic perfume
ayurvedic-hair-oil.body: As someone who studies Ayurveda, I immediately checked the ingredient list. The presence of authentic herbs like Jatamansi and Kalonji provides real scalp nourishment without mineral oil fillers. Truly pure nature and care.

ayurvedic-hair-oil.author: Meera Nair
ayurvedic-hair-oil.title: Lovely fragrance and zero stickiness
ayurvedic-hair-oil.body: It washes out easily with the Umanarayani shampoo and leaves my hair glowing. Highly recommend doing an overnight champi.

herbal-shampoo.author: Rohan Kapoor
herbal-shampoo.title: Cleanses thoroughly without drying like chemical shampoos
herbal-shampoo.body: Reetha and Shikakai give a surprisingly gentle and rich lather. Scalp feels squeaky clean yet moisturized. Pairs magically with the hair oil.

herbal-shampoo.author: Pooja Verma
herbal-shampoo.title: Natural shine is back!
herbal-shampoo.body: My frizz has tamed down considerably. No sulphates or parabens, which is a big relief for sensitive scalps.

orange-face-wash.author: Sanya Gupta
orange-face-wash.title: Instantly removes tanning after sun exposure!
orange-face-wash.body: The fresh orange peel aroma is heavenly and authentic, not like artificial scents. Cleared up stubborn forehead pimples in just 10 days.

orange-face-wash.author: Aditya Mehta
orange-face-wash.title: Controls midday oiliness very effectively
orange-face-wash.body: Perfect morning face cleanser. Doesn't leave the skin feeling tight or stretchy.
